 Market standoff and lock-up agreements | Our directors, officers, and the holders of substantially all of our capital stock and securities convertible into or exchangeable for our capital stock, representing an aggregate of approximately 15.5 billion shares of our Class A common stock (including shares issuable upon the conversion of our outstanding Class N common stock, upon the exercise or settlement of outstanding equity awards, and upon full conversion of outstanding convertible promissory notes), have entered into market standoff agreements with us or have entered into lock-up agreements with the underwriters that, subject to specified exceptions, restrict transfers of their shares for up to 180 days or, in the case of our co-founders and certain of our stockholders holding more than 0.5% of our fully diluted shares prior to this offering, up to 365 days after the date of this prospectus. Of these shares, 3.7 billion shares subject to the 180-day lock-up and market standoff period may become eligible for sale prior to the expiration of that period, including up to 10% of the aggregate number of lock-up securities held by our non-founder directors, officers, and current and former employees and consultants, which may be transferred or sold beginning on the first trading day of our Class A common stock. See the sections titled “Shares Eligible for Future Sale” and “Underwriting.”
